titles.title: I'm Done Being the Good Daughter-in-Law
The Good Daughter-in-Law No Longer Exists

description:
Murdered alongside her unborn child by her husband and in-laws, a woman who wanted nothing but love gets a second chance at life—and the perfect opportunity for revenge. She drives out her son-obsessed mother-in-law and slowly strips her ex-husband of everything he holds dear. Along the way, she joins forces with a mysterious man who offers to help her, but they agree on one thing: love is the last thing they want. 

Yet as their partnership deepens, he finds himself falling for her, terrified that once her revenge is complete, she will leave him behind.
